children: Overview
Canada gold miner's Q3 revenue rose 9% yr/yr despite 18% drop in gold production
Q3 net income and EBITDA both increased yr/yr, supported by higher realized gold prices
Company reaffirmed 2026 production and AISC guidance, expects Q4 to be strongest quarter
Outlook
Wesdome maintains 2026 gold production guidance at 180,000-205,000 oz, expects results below midpoint
Company expects 2026 consolidated AISC per ounce sold near top end of US$1,525-US$1,700 range
Full-year cash costs per ounce could track up to 10% higher than US$1,050-US$1,150 guidance
Result Drivers
HIGHER GOLD PRICES - Co said increased average realized gold price offset lower production and supported revenue growth
EAGLE RIVER THROUGHPUT - Co said record quarterly throughput at Eagle River was achieved, though lower grade reduced gold output
KIENA WORKFORCE GAPS - Co said seasonal workforce gaps at Kiena reduced equipment utilization and delayed mining sequence
